versions.short: The bill would raise the debt limit for small business reorganization bankruptcies under Subchapter V from about $3.4 million to $7.5 million. It would also raise the overall debt limit for wage earner's plan bankruptcies under Chapter 13 from about $2.1 million to $2.75 million. In addition, it would count both secured and unsecured debt toward that Chapter 13 limit, instead of applying separate limits to each type.
